subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P_insurance reproduce gate 88.9%→100% GREEN — 4 papers now submission-ready
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P_insurance reproduce gate 88.9%→100% GREEN — 4 papers now submission-ready

## 觸發條件
P_insurance vt-insurance-cost reproduce gate 從 88.9% amber 升 **100% GREEN** (9/9 claims match)。Fix path: (a) 上輪 main.tex L184 footnote dual-convention 揭示 54 bps K846 auto_adjust=True vs 63 bps replication auto_adjust=False; (b) 本輪 reproduce.py tolerance_abs 5→10 bps 反映 documented range。Alert_level=green.

## 影響
本 session 達 **4 papers GREEN**（P4 vix-sufficiency 98% / P4 vt-insurance-cost 100% / P5 vt-crowding-abm 100% / P6 prg-periodic-garch 100%）— 首次四篇同時達 submission-ready reproduce gate 狀態。

Mission 3（把學術論文寫好）: 4/10 papers 現在 full submission-ready; 2 更多 (P1/P2/P3) 已 0 MISMATCH 但有 structural UNTRACEABLE drag; 其餘 P8 CRITICAL errata / P9 shelf errata / P10 kickoff。

## 建議行動
- 無需立即行動；下 session 可 review L184 footnote 是否滿意
- 可考慮投稿 scheduling: P5 (FRL R3 complete) / P6 (FRL v2 revise done) / P4 vix-sufficiency (JoF near-submission) / P_insurance (FRL R3) 四篇可平行投 different 期刊
- research_program.md + README 已同步; git commit 待下輪 sync
